# 36 North Property Management

> > Full-service property management company serving Monterey County and Salinas, California, specializing in residential rental properties, landlord education, and California rental law compliance.

36 North Property Management provides comprehensive property management services in the Monterey Bay area, with expertise in California legislation including AB 1482, Section 8 housing, rent control laws, and investment property strategies. The company offers landlord resources, tenant portals, and guidance on regulatory compliance for rental property owners.

## Key Topics

- Monterey County property management
- Salinas rental properties
- California rental laws (AB 1482, SB 330)
- Section 8 housing programs
- Rent control and tenant protections
- Property maintenance strategies
- Landlord-tenant compliance
- Investment property ROI
- Governor Newsom housing legislation
- Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act
- Proposition 10
- Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)
- AppFolio property management software
- Fire safety compliance
- Rental collection best practices

## Core Services & Portals

- [36 North Property Management | Resident Portal](https://www.36northpm.com/residents): Resident portal for rent payment, maintenance requests, and documents
